text:
Maya Chen: Sticker wall lottery! Found a stack of retro stickers in the loot box. Anyone want a mystery sticker? Reply with a one-liner to enter. Winner gets first pick. :sparkles:

Jon R: One-liner: "My plant judges my productivity."

Priya Patel: One-liner: "Coffee is just bean soup." ☕️

Devon: I call dibs on any cactus. One-liner: "I water my plants with good intentions." :seedling:

sticker-bot: Reminder: React with :thumbsup: if you want to be entered. (Automated draw in 30m!)

Maya Chen: @sticker-bot thanks! Also small poll: react :one: retro, :two: tech, :three: puns. Vote with emoji.

Ava (People Ops): One-liner: "My headphones are my cape." Also :one:

Jon R: Adding :thumbsup: and also "I name my plants after APIs."

Priya Patel: Also kudos to @Devon for organizing the sticker stash :clap:

Devon: lol thanks. Drawing now... drumroll please :drum:

sticker-bot: Draw complete — winner is @Priya Patel. Congrats! DM sent with pickup deets.

Priya Patel: :squee: thank you! I'll trade for a mini succulent if anyone's into swaps.

Maya Chen: Love a swap. @Jon R you said you wanted to trade? :seedling:

Jon R: Yes please. I'll leave a tiny keyboard sticker and a note. meet-by-kitchen?

sticker-bot: Sticker wall tally updated. Have a great afternoon everyone! :tada:
